name: parse_ooxml_and_pdf
logic_name: OOXML And PDF Text Normalization With Provenance

test_list.description: Generated DOCX content becomes paragraphs without claiming XML source lines.
Generated workbook sheets and cell values become tables with sheet provenance.
Text pages become blocks with stable page-number provenance.
PDF pages with no text layer return an honest typed OCR-unavailable result.
Malformed container bytes return typed errors.
Generated workbook and presentation content is parsed through calamine and OOXML readers; a far-away cell dimension is rejected before calamine allocation.

output_description: Normalized structure with source page/sheet provenance or typed error.
